rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:

        $c = "CryptEncrypt" fullword ascii
    condition:

}
